title: Multiplayer, Accessibility, Performance & Golden Native-Tabletop Proof
objective: Prove the completed native tabletop experience under multiplayer, reconnect/rejoin, stale/conflict and GM-adjudication conditions; mobile/tablet, keyboard and nonvisual accessibility; large-map and animated-asset performance; audio-disabled operation; hidden-information protection; and deterministic authoritative results, culminating in a golden proof from legitimate asset/prepared Scene through live encounter, interactive region/object, audiovisual transition and post-Scene state without replacing any canonical owner authority.

persistence.reason: ISE-08 produces bounded synchronization/accessibility/performance and golden-proof receipts over existing canonical Scene/owner/MAI/AAI state. Validation evidence is ephemeral/artifact-level; no new canonical owner record or durable runtime ledger is introduced.

preserved_boundaries: ISE-01..07 remain completed_verified with no reopened implementation authority.

Scene, World/Reality, Action/Event, Combat, Character, Creature, Item/Asset, Vehicle, permissions, MAI and AAI remain canonical; ISE-08 synchronization and proof receipts exercise but do not replace those authorities.
Remote clients cannot promote local presentation, camera, token or accessibility state into canonical truth without normal permission, expected-version/idempotency and owner-domain validation.
Reconnect/rejoin and stale/conflict handling fail closed rather than overwrite newer authoritative state; GM adjudication remains available for unresolved conflicts.
Hidden/GM-only information, protected cardinality and provider secrets are filtered before network, player, accessibility, diagnostic, export or AI projection.
Mobile/tablet, keyboard and nonvisual equivalents preserve consequential information/actions without making the visual canvas the sole authoritative representation.
Large maps, animated assets, degraded/missing media and audio-disabled operation cannot alter deterministic authoritative results or block play.
Golden proof uses legitimate references/evidence only; no paid provider activation, media redistribution, credential embedding or entitlement inference is introduced.
Migration 0022 remains unreserved and no durable ISE-08 runtime/session/proof ledger is created.
SSA-01 is the strict successor only after ISE-08 completion; no SSA implementation authority is granted by this governed start.
No tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
next_action: Validate and merge this exact ISE-08 governed-start AIOC candidate. Only after Repository Health passes may the registered application branch be created at 3e77365c9e4eef8d76fe9c9358a6de6d2bf82b24 and product source mutate.
